title: Sum from 1 to n
goal: sum_to(n) must add every whole number from 1 up to and including n.
starter:
def sum_to(n):
    total = 0
    for number in range(1, n):
        total += number
    return total


# Try it: sum_to(3) should be 6, because 1 + 2 + 3 = 6
print(sum_to(3))
concept: (n ?\+ ?1|inclusiv|exclusiv|stops? (before|short|at)|before n|not includ|leaves? (out|off)|missing|one short|off.by.one|one number early|never reach)
fallbackHint: Look at the loop line: range(1, n) stops before n, so for n = 3 the loop visits 1 and 2 and never 3. Which number is missing from your total, and where does the loop decide when to stop?

title: Largest number in a list
bugClass: Bad starting value / hidden test case
goal: find_max(numbers) must return the largest value in the list, including when every value is negative.
fallbackHint: One test passes and one fails - that is the interesting part. What does best hold before the loop runs, and can a negative number ever be bigger than that starting value?

title: Remove the negative numbers
bugClass: Mutating a list while looping over it
goal: drop_negatives(numbers) must return the list with every negative number removed and the rest in their original order.
fallbackHint: Two negative numbers sit next to each other: -1 and -4. When -1 is removed, what happens to the position of -4, and where is the loop's next step looking?

title: Add up the prices
bugClass: Variable read before it is given a value
goal: total_price(prices) must return the sum of all prices, and 0 for an empty list.
fallbackHint: The error calls total a local variable that was read before it had a value. Find the line where total is supposed to be created - does that line exist yet?

title: Build a sentence from a number
bugClass: Joining text and a number with +
goal: describe_age(age) must return text like "You are 12 years old".
fallbackHint: Read the error type first: TypeError, not ValueError. Python refuses to glue text and a number with +. What type is age, and what type does the thing on the left of + expect?
